events.name: Boston Red Sox at New York Yankees
Los Angeles Dodgers at Detroit Tigers

headlines.description: — Javier Báez made huge ninth-inning plays in the field and at the plate to set up Kevin McGonigle's game-ending single as the Detroit Tigers beat the Los Angeles Dodgers 2-1 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Báez makes ninth-inning plays with glove and bat to lead Tigers past Dodgers, 2-1

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Minnesota Twins

headlines.description: — Andrew Benintendi had all three of Chicago's hits, with his sixth-inning home run being the difference, as the White Sox beat the Minnesota Twins 3-2 Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Benintendi has all three Chicago hits, including a home run, as White Sox beat Twins 3-2

events.name: Pittsburgh Pirates at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Rafael Flores Jr. hit a three-run home run and Brandon Lowe added a solo shot to lift the Pittsburgh Pirates to a 6-2 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flores Jr., Lowe hit homers to spark Pirates to 6-2 win over Cardinals

headlines.description: — Pete Crow-Armstrong homered three times and drove in six runs, helping the Cubs beat Sal Stewart and the Cincinnati Reds 17-5 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pete Crow-Armstrong homers 3 times as the Chicago Cubs pound the Cincinnati Reds 17-5

events.name: Seattle Mariners at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Alejandro Kirk drove in the tiebreaking run with a two-out single in the sixth inning and the Toronto Blue Jays beat the Seattle Mariners 4-3 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alejandro Kirk has tiebreaking hit in 6th inning as Blue Jays beat Mariners 4-3

headlines.description: — Dylan Crews hit an RBI single with two out in the 10th inning to give the Washington Nationals a 5-4 win over the Miami Marlins on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dylan Crews hits an RBI single in 10th sends Nationals past Marlins, 5-4

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Michael Harris II hit a two-out, two-run double in the eighth inning to lift the Atlanta Braves to a 2-1 win over the Colorado Rockies, the sixth straight for the National League East leaders.
headlines.shortLinkText: Michael Harris II’s 2-run double lifts the Braves past the Rockies 2-1 for 6th straight win

events.name: Houston Astros at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Juan Soto, activated from the 10-day injured list before the game, had the go-ahead RBI single a pitch after fouling a ball off his right leg Saturday, leading the New York Mets to a 6-2 victory over the Houston Astros.
headlines.shortLinkText: Juan Soto returns to help the Mets beat the Astros 6-2

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Cleveland Guardians

headlines.description: — Josh Rojas had his second career game with four RBI, Salvador Perez hit two doubles and the Kansas City Royals defeated the Cleveland Guardians 8-3 on Saturday for their 12th win in 13 games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Rojas powers Royals past Guardians 8-3 as Kansas City wins 12th in 13 games

events.name: San Diego Padres at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Yandy Diaz knocked in three runs with a bases-loaded single in the seventh inning and Chandler Simpson followed with a tiebreaking RBI hit as the Tampa Bay Rays rallied to beat San Diego 7-6 on Saturday in a game in which Padres second baseman Luis...
headlines.shortLinkText: Simpson's RBI single caps 4-run 7th inning as Rays rally to defeat Padres 7-6

events.name: Boston Red Sox at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Ben Rice had a two-run single in New York's five-run eighth inning and finished with three RBI as the Yankees beat the Boston Red Sox 9-2 Saturday in the nightcap and earned a doubleheader split.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rice drives in 3 runs as Yankees beat Red Sox 9-2 to earn a doubleheader split

headlines.description: — Jackson Chourio and William Contreras homered in the first inning and the Milwaukee Brewers stayed ahead the rest of the way to defeat the Texas Rangers 5-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson Chourio and William Contreras homer early in Brewers' 5-3 victory over Rangers

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Bryce Eldridge had four hits and drove in four runs and the San Francisco Giants beat the Arizona Diamondbacks 7-2 on Saturday night to split a doubleheader.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eldridge has 4 hits, drives in 4 runs as Giants beat Diamondbacks 7-2 to split doubleheader

headlines.description: — Leody Taveras broke out of an 0-for-12 slump with two doubles and three RBI in the Baltimore Orioles’ 5-3 victory over the Athletics on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Leody Taveras drives in 3 as the Orioles beat the Athletics 5-3

events.name: Philadelphia Phillies at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Kyle Schwarber hit a go-ahead RBI single and Trea Turner had a two-run single in a three-run 10th inning in the Philadelphia Phillies' 4-2 victory over the Los Angeles Angels on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sanchez sharp, Schwarber, Turner have 10th-inning hits in Phillies' 4-2 win over Angels
